admin.settings.url_cleaning_enabled: Remove tracking parameters when creating short links
admin.settings.url_cleaning_hint: Off by default. Applies to new links from every form and API. Built-in rules cover Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X/Twitter, YouTube, TikTok and Bilibili. Existing links and target edits stay unchanged; share links are not expanded.
admin.settings.url_cleaning_format: One rule per line: example.com utm_* ref. Matches that domain and its subdomains. Parameter names ignore ASCII case; a final * matches a prefix. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
admin.settings.url_cleaning_limits: Up to 8192 bytes, 100 rules, 32 parameters per rule and 64 characters per parameter. Use hostnames without schemes, ports, paths or wildcards. Leave empty to use only the built-in rules.
admin.settings.url_cleaning_warning: Custom rules can remove required parameters and change a destination. Remove only names you recognize as tracking; built-in rules keep video IDs, playlists and playback times.
admin.settings.url_cleaning_error: Rules were not saved. Check that each line has a hostname and 1–32 parameter names (letters, digits, _, - or ., with an optional final *). Hostname labels must be 1–63 characters, without a leading or trailing hyphen. Check the size limits above; your submitted rules are kept below.
admin.settings.public_shortener_hint: The form on the landing page. An anonymous visitor creates links owned by the reserved Guest account; those links cannot be edited by their creator.

admin.settings.public_rate_per_ip_hint: 0 disables the limit. The address is the client address, or the one a trusted proxy forwards.
admin.settings.public_rate_global: Creations per hour from all visitors together
admin.settings.public_rate_global_hint: A single budget every anonymous visitor draws from, on top of the per-address limit. 0 disables it.
admin.settings.public_fields_hint: The target URL is always required. Only the fields enabled here are accepted: a submission that fills in a disabled field is refused.
